definitions.explanation: The heart and the lungs taken together, as the organs that keep a person breathing and the blood circulating. Used mainly in medicine, first aid, and sports training, almost always inside a compound.

examples.japanese: {心肺|しんぱい}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心肺|しんぱい}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: The man was brought in in cardiopulmonary arrest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{居合|いあ}わせた→居合わせる：12394_iawaseru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{心肺|しんぱい}⟦{蘇生|そせい}→蘇生：14029_sosei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: A bystander kept up CPR until the ambulance arrived.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心肺|しんぱい}⟦{蘇生|そせい}→蘇生：14029_sosei⟧: cardiopulmonary resuscitation, CPR
- {心肺|しんぱい}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: cardiopulmonary arrest
- {心肺|しんぱい}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧: heart and lung function, aerobic fitness
- {人工心肺|じんこうしんぱい}: heart-lung machine

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as the everyday word ⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧ (worry). In speech, context separates them: {心肺|しんぱい} almost never stands alone and appears in the medical compounds above.
